title: Atlas Scientific Reproduction Report v4
description: scientific-reproduction-report.v4: the v3 tabular report (unchanged, $defs/tabular_report) plus the univariate_forecasting report produced by the temporal protocol runner ($defs/forecasting_report): temporal protocol, candidate catalog, backtesting execution, eligibility and failures, selection trace, final fit, the single final forecast and evaluation, the primary-baseline reference, the holdout exposure record and lineage separation. No class, positive class or threshold concept is invented.
